MRI Information
The Orion Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 100 T/m/s per axis.
- Use the body transmit coil.
- B1+rms ≤ 2 microtesla; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 2 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 60 min.
- A cooling period of 60 minutes is required between scans.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
